title: 第21章 知子莫父第22章 苏家的碑
content_zh:
夜幕四合，苏家村的田野里蛙声如潮，与空气中弥漫的湿润泥土气息交织在一起，构成了一幅大旱之后久违的丰年图景。
苏秦独自立于田埂之上，借着微弱的月光，目光紧紧锁死在那淡蓝色的面板之上。
那一栏新出现的法术——《春风化雨》，此刻正散发着一种难以言喻的诱惑力。
“春风化雨……”
苏秦在心中反复咀嚼着这四个字。
他记得很清楚，在听雨轩的那堂课上，胡教习提及此术时的郑重其事。
那是连林清寒那等天之骄女，都需要胡教习单独开小灶去打磨的“杀手锏”。
胡教习曾言，只要林清寒能将此术修至二级，便有八成把握冲击青云府前十，进入那传说中的“种子班”。
要知道，林清寒本身便是聚元二层大圆满，且身怀八门二级辅助法术。
即便如此，这门《春风化雨》依然是她能否登顶的决定性砝码。
“究竟有何神异？”
苏秦心念微动，神识缓缓沉入那新生成的法术符文之中。
嗡——
并没有晦涩难懂的咒文，只有一段玄奥至极的感悟，如涓涓细流般淌过心田。
片刻后，苏秦猛地睁开双眼，瞳孔深处闪过一丝恍然大悟的精芒。
“原来如此！”
“原来这便是‘春风’二字的真意！”
寻常的《唤雨术》，唤来的不过是凡水，顶多解一解庄稼的焦渴，除此之外，再无他用。
而《春风化雨》，其核心不在“水”，而在“气”。
它是将施法者体内的精纯元气，揉碎了，化开了，融入每一滴雨水之中。

这就好比是用稀释后的灵液去灌溉庄稼！
“带有元气的雨水……”
苏秦深吸一口气，心中掀起惊涛骇浪
“若是常年以此水灌溉，土壤中的板结自会解开，变得松软透气；
杂草的生机会被灵谷压制，甚至无需除草；
贫瘠的土地会因为元气的滋养而变得肥沃流油！”
“这一门法术，便包含了松土、肥地、催生、养护等等多重功效！”
“这就是降维打击！”
难怪藏经阁中，此术非二级院弟子不可兑换，且标价高达五十两纹银。
这哪里是法术，这分明就是给那些想拿“甲”等评级的学子准备的作弊器！
只要掌握了它，哪怕只是v1，哪怕不学其他任何辅助法术，苏秦也有绝对的自信，将那两亩责任田种出花来！
“稳了。”
苏秦握紧了拳头，这几日不眠不休的疲惫，在这一刻尽数化作了踏实。
毕竟，他进入内舍时间太少，底蕴太浅，而一个月后就要考核。
他的首要目的，不是去争什么前十，而是晋级。
只要凭借此术，能通过考核、晋升二级院，便已足够。
平复下激动的心情，苏秦又将目光投向了另外两门进阶法术。
content_en:
As night falls, the sound of frogs in the fields of Sujia Village is intertwined with the moist earthy smell in the air, forming a picture of a long-lost harvest after a severe drought.
Su Qin stood alone on the field ridge, with his eyes firmly fixed on the light blue panel under the faint moonlight.
The newly appeared spell in that column - "Spring Breeze Turns into Rain", is exuding an indescribable allure at the moment.
"Spring breeze turns into rain..."
Su Qin chewed these four words over and over in his heart.
He remembered very clearly the seriousness with which Hu taught Xi when he mentioned this technique in Ting Yuxuan's class.
That was the "killer trump card" that even a proud girl like Lin Qinghan needed Hu Jiaoxi to work on on his own.
Hu Jiaoxi once said that as long as Lin Qinghan can cultivate this technique to the second level, he is 80% sure to reach the top ten of Qingyun Mansion and enter the legendary "Seed Class".
You know, Lin Qinghan himself is the second-level Dzogchen of Juyuan, and possesses eight second-level auxiliary spells.
Even so, this "Spring Breeze and Rain" is still the decisive weight for whether she can reach the top.
"What's so special about it?"
Su Qin's mind moved slightly, and his consciousness slowly sank into the newly generated spell runes.
Buzz——
There is no obscure incantation, only a profound insight flowing through my heart like a trickle.
After a moment, Su Qin suddenly opened his eyes, and a flash of enlightenment flashed deep in his pupils.
"That's it!"
"It turns out that this is the true meaning of the word 'spring breeze'!"
The ordinary "Rain Calling Technique" can only summon ordinary water, which can at most quench the thirst of crops, but has no other use.
The core of "Spring Breeze Turns into Rain" is not "water", but "qi".
It crushes the pure vitality in the caster's body, melts it, and blends it into every drop of rain.
This is like using diluted spiritual liquid to irrigate crops!
"The rain with vitality..."
Su Qin took a deep breath and felt a storm in his heart.
“If you irrigate with this water all year round, the hard knots in the soil will loosen and become soft and breathable;
The growth of weeds will be suppressed by Spirit Valley, and weeding will not even be necessary;
The barren land will become fertile and flowing with the nourishment of vitality! "
"This spell contains multiple functions such as loosening the soil, fertilizing the land, promoting growth, and maintaining it!"
"This is a dimensionality reduction strike!"
No wonder in the Sutra Pavilion, this technique cannot be redeemed by non-second-level disciples, and the price is as high as fifty taels of silver.
This isn't a spell, it's clearly a cheating device for students who want to get an "A" rating!
As long as he masters it, even if it is only v1, even if he does not learn any other auxiliary spells, Su Qin will have absolute confidence to cultivate those two acres of responsible fields!
"Stable."
Su Qin clenched his fists, and the fatigue of the past few days turned into solidity at this moment.
After all, he had been in the inner house for too little time, and his background was too shallow, and he would be taking the assessment in a month.
His primary goal is not to compete for the top ten, but to advance.
As long as you can pass the assessment and be promoted to the second level academy with this technique, it is enough.
After calming down his excitement, Su Qin turned his attention to two other advanced spells.
